reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis proposes a W(Cu) solid solution, which contradicts the well-established immiscibility of W and Cu (positive heat of mixing) and the absence of equilibrium solid solubility; rapid quenching cannot overcome this fundamental thermodynamic barrier.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comparative, but the falsification criterion relies on a physically impossible outcome (W(Cu) solid solution), making the test effectively a test of an impossibility rather than a decisive evaluation of the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamentally flawed materials science premise (forming a W-Cu solid solution), which would misdirect research efforts away from viable approaches to improve W-Cu composites.
